'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Carl Buck LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Carl Buck]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
